faq_heading: 2 bedroom townhomes in Chilliwack: your questions answered

faq.q: What is the price of a 2 bedroom townhome in Chilliwack right now?
faq.a: Of the 2 bedroom townhomes in Chilliwack, 58 sold over the past year at a median of $388,750, with the middle half between $268,000 and $536,500.

faq.q: Are 2 bedroom townhomes in Chilliwack selling quickly?
faq.a: The median was 28 days, and homes sold for 96.7% of the list price at a median.

faq.q: Which parts of Chilliwack sell the most 2 bedroom townhomes?
faq.a: Sardis West Vedder, with 23 of the 58 sales at a median of $368,500.

faq.q: Which buildings in Chilliwack have 2 bedroom townhomes for sale most often?
faq.a: By sales over the past year: Cottonwood Retirement Village (5 sales, median $229,000); Cottonwood Village (4 sales); Hazelwood Grove (3 sales); Wellsbrooke (3 sales).

faq.q: What is the strata fee on a 2 bedroom townhome in Chilliwack?
faq.a: The median strata fee on the 2 bedroom townhomes that sold in Chilliwack was $337 a month. Fees vary by building, so check the building's own figure.

blocks.text: How 2 bedroom townhomes in Chilliwack compare
A 2 bedroom townhome in Chilliwack sold for $225,000 less at the median than a 3 bedroom or larger one ($388,750 against $613,750, 268 sales). The strata fee was $337 a month against $398.
Of the 6 cities with 2 bedroom townhome pages, Chilliwack has the lowest median price. Chilliwack is lowest at $388,750 and South Surrey highest at $780,000.
